title: Indicator pairing from an exponential moment
statement: Let $f,g:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, with $f$ taking only the values $0$ and $1$, and suppose its uniform expectation $\alpha=\mathbb E f$ is positive. For any $t,b\in\mathbb R$, if $\mathbb E e^{tg}\le e^b$, then $t\,\mathbb E[fg]\le\alpha\bigl(b-\log\alpha\bigr)$.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ have uniform mean $\alpha>0$, let $g:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, and let $t,b\in\bbr$. If $\E[e^{tg}]\le e^b$, then $t\E[fg]\le\alpha(b-\log\alpha)$.
